notes_for_editor: Two listings only. websiteservice gives coordinates for Piskwakau and nothing else. Its 'New cupola 1959' note sits under the Fort House entry, the tower listed just before Piskwakau, so it is not attributed to Piskwakau here. Canada Lookouts lists both Piskwaka and Pushwakau on its Saskatchewan index, and has a picture-only Pushwakau section that could not be read as text; the sources do not say whether these are one tower or two, and the story says so. The brief's agency (SPSA, formerly DNR) is not confirmed by any page read. Canada Lookouts also has a Puskwaskau page under a different name; it was not read and is not used. Access, status and staffing are unknown; no current-site source was found.
